fullText.simplified:
第7章、你害怕什么

    妹妹给高尔送吃的东西，虽然只看到了妹妹的一只手，但高尔还是很高兴。
    高尔一下子有了力气。他爬下床，来到碟子旁边，吃起了面包，喝起了牛奶。面包真好吃，牛奶真好喝！他已经几天没有吃一点儿东西了，他太爱面包和牛奶了！但是高尔只高兴了一会儿，吃饱后的他又开始担心和难过了。
    刚刚高尔只看到了妹妹的手，他不知道妹妹的脸是什么样子的，妹妹还像那天一样害怕吗？晚上，妹妹从学校回来了。她轻轻地推开门，飞快地拿走了碟子和杯子。高尔还是只能看到妹妹的手，他想和妹妹说说话，但是他不敢发出声音。
    就这样，一个星期过去了。
    每天早上，妹妹从门外推进来一个碟子。晚上，妹妹再把碟子拿走。高尔和妹妹没有说一个字，也没有看到过妹妹的脸。高尔也没有看到爸爸和妈妈，他们没有推开过高尔的房门。有时候，高尔真想爬出去看看他们，但他不敢，他害怕。
    晚上，在黑黑的房间里，他好像听到娃娃问：“你害怕什么？”
    他不知道怎么回答。他不会回答，他不敢回答。但是，这还不是最让他难过的事情。每天，他想得最多的问题是，他不能工作了，家里马上就没钱了，怎么办？
    以前家里有个保姆，就住在楼下，每天帮家里做些家务，照顾爸爸和妈妈。这几天，高尔已经没有听到这个保姆的声音了。是因为没有钱，所以爸爸妈妈让保姆离开了吗？如果保姆离开了，那谁来照顾爸爸妈妈呢？爸爸老了，妈妈身体不好，他们需要人照顾啊！还有妹妹，那可爱的妹妹，她的学费怎么办？她那么喜欢弹钢琴，她要去音乐学校。现在没有钱交学费，她怎么去音乐学校呢？还有爸爸欠银行的那些钱，是每个月都要还的，怎么办呢？
fullText.traditional:
第7章、你害怕什麼

    妹妹給高爾送吃的東西，雖然只看到了妹妹的一隻手，但高爾還是很高興。
    高爾一下子有了力氣。他爬下床，來到碟子旁邊，吃起了麵包，喝起了牛奶。麵包真好吃，牛奶真好喝！他已經幾天沒有吃一點兒東西了，他太愛麵包和牛奶了！但是高爾只高興了一會兒，吃飽後的他又開始擔心和難過了。
    剛剛高爾只看到了妹妹的手，他不知道妹妹的臉是什麼樣子的，妹妹還像那天一樣害怕嗎？晚上，妹妹從學校回來了。她輕輕地推開門，飛快地拿走了碟子和杯子。高爾還是只能看到妹妹的手，他想和妹妹說說話，但是他不敢發出聲音。
    就這樣，一個星期過去了。
    每天早上，妹妹從門外推進來一個碟子。晚上，妹妹再把碟子拿走。高爾和妹妹沒有說一個字，也沒有看到過妹妹的臉。高爾也沒有看到爸爸和媽媽，他們沒有推開過高爾的房門。有時候，高爾真想爬出去看看他們，但他不敢，他害怕。
    晚上，在黑黑的房間裡，他好像聽到娃娃問：“你害怕什麼？”
    他不知道怎麼回答。他不會回答，他不敢回答。但是，這還不是最讓他難過的事情。每天，他想得最多的問題是，他不能工作了，家裡馬上就沒錢了，怎麼辦？
    以前家裡有個保姆，就住在樓下，每天幫家裡做些家務，照顧爸爸和媽媽。這幾天，高爾已經沒有聽到這個保姆的聲音了。是因為沒有錢，所以爸爸媽媽讓保姆離開了嗎？如果保姆離開了，那誰來照顧爸爸媽媽呢？爸爸老了，媽媽身體不好，他們需要人照顧啊！還有妹妹，那可愛的妹妹，她的學費怎麼辦？她那麼喜歡彈鋼琴，她要去音樂學校。現在沒有錢交學費，她怎麼去音樂學校呢？還有爸爸欠銀行的那些錢，是每個月都要還的，怎麼辦呢？

sentences.simplified: 妹妹给高尔送吃的东西，虽然只看到了妹妹的一只手，但高尔还是很高兴。
sentences.traditional: 妹妹給高爾送吃的東西，雖然只看到了妹妹的一隻手，但高爾還是很高興。
sentences.pinyin: mèi mei gěi gāo ěr sòng chī de dōng xi suī rán zhǐ kàn dào le mèi mei de yì zhī shǒu dàn gāo ěr hái shi hěn gāo xìng
sentences.english: Gao Er’s little sister brought him some food. Although he only saw his little sister’s hand, Gao Er was still very happy.

sentences.simplified: 高尔一下子有了力气。
sentences.traditional: 高爾一下子有了力氣。
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr yí xià zi yǒu le lì qi
sentences.english: Gao Er suddenly gained strength.

sentences.simplified: 他爬下床，来到碟子旁边，吃起了面包，喝起了牛奶。
sentences.traditional: 他爬下床，來到碟子旁邊，吃起了麵包，喝起了牛奶。
sentences.pinyin: tā pá xià chuáng lái dào dié zi páng biān chī qǐ le miàn bāo hē qǐ le niú nǎi
sentences.english: He crawled down from the bed and went to the plate. He started eating bread and drinking milk.

sentences.simplified: 面包真好吃，牛奶真好喝！
sentences.traditional: 麵包真好吃，牛奶真好喝！
sentences.pinyin: miàn bāo zhēn hǎo chī niú nǎi zhēn hǎo hē
sentences.english: The bread was really delicious, and the milk was really good!

sentences.simplified: 他已经几天没有吃一点儿东西了，他太爱面包和牛奶了！
sentences.traditional: 他已經幾天沒有吃一點兒東西了，他太愛麵包和牛奶了！
sentences.pinyin: tā yǐ jīng jǐ tiān méi yǒu chī yì diǎn'r dōng xi le tā tài ài miàn bāo hé niú nǎi le
sentences.english: He hadn’t eaten anything for several days. He loved bread and milk so much!

sentences.simplified: 但是高尔只高兴了一会儿，吃饱后的他又开始担心和难过了。
sentences.traditional: 但是高爾只高興了一會兒，吃飽後的他又開始擔心和難過了。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì gāo ěr zhǐ gāo xìng le yí huì'r chī bǎo hòu de tā yòu kāi shǐ dān xīn hé nán guò le
sentences.english: But Gao Er was only happy for a moment. After he finished eating, he began to worry and feel sad again.

sentences.simplified: 刚刚高尔只看到了妹妹的手，
sentences.traditional: 剛剛高爾只看到了妹妹的手，
sentences.pinyin: gāng gang gāo ěr zhǐ kàn dào le mèi mei de shǒu
sentences.english: Just now, Gao Er only saw his little sister’s hand.

sentences.simplified: 他不知道妹妹的脸是什么样子的，妹妹还像那天一样害怕吗？
sentences.traditional: 他不知道妹妹的臉是什麼樣子的，妹妹還像那天一樣害怕嗎？
sentences.pinyin: tā bù zhī dào mèi mei de liǎn shì shén me yàng zi de mèi mei hái xiàng nà tiān yí yàng hài pà ma
sentences.english: He didn’t know what his little sister’s face looked like. Was she still as scared as she was that day?

sentences.simplified: 晚上，妹妹从学校回来了。
sentences.traditional: 晚上，妹妹從學校回來了。
sentences.pinyin: wǎn shang mèi mei cóng xué xiào huí lái le
sentences.english: In the evening, his little sister came back from school.

sentences.simplified: 她轻轻地推开门，飞快地拿走了碟子和杯子。
sentences.traditional: 她輕輕地推開門，飛快地拿走了碟子和杯子。
sentences.pinyin: tā qīng qīng de tuī kāi mén fēi kuài de ná zǒu le dié zi hé bēi zi
sentences.english: She gently pushed the door open and quickly took away the plate and the cup.

sentences.simplified: 高尔还是只能看到妹妹的手，
sentences.traditional: 高爾還是只能看到妹妹的手，
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr hái shi zhǐ néng kàn dào mèi mei de shǒu
sentences.english: Gao Er could still only see his little sister’s hand.

sentences.simplified: 他想和妹妹说说话，但是他不敢发出声音。
sentences.traditional: 他想和妹妹說說話，但是他不敢發出聲音。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiǎng hé mèi mei shuō shuō huà dàn shì tā bù gǎn fā chū shēng yīn
sentences.english: He wanted to talk to his little sister, but he didn’t dare to make a sound.

sentences.simplified: 就这样，一个星期过去了。
sentences.traditional: 就這樣，一個星期過去了。
sentences.pinyin: jiù zhè yàng yí ge xīng qī guò qù le
sentences.english: Just like that, one week passed.

sentences.simplified: 每天早上，妹妹从门外推进来一个碟子。
sentences.traditional: 每天早上，妹妹從門外推進來一個碟子。
sentences.pinyin: měi tiān zǎo shang mèi mei cóng mén wài tuī jìn lái yí ge dié zi
sentences.english: Every morning, Gao Er’s little sister would push a plate in from outside the door.

sentences.simplified: 晚上，妹妹再把碟子拿走。
sentences.traditional: 晚上，妹妹再把碟子拿走。
sentences.pinyin: wǎn shang mèi mei zài bǎ dié zi ná zǒu
sentences.english: In the evening, his little sister would take the plate away.

sentences.simplified: 高尔和妹妹没有说一个字，也没有看到过妹妹的脸。
sentences.traditional: 高爾和妹妹沒有說一個字，也沒有看到過妹妹的臉。
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr hé mèi mei méi yǒu shuō yí ge zì yě méi yǒu kàn dào guò mèi mei de liǎn
sentences.english: Gao Er did not exchange any words with his little sister, nor did he see his little sister’s face.

sentences.simplified: 高尔也没有看到爸爸和妈妈，他们没有推开过高尔的房门。
sentences.traditional: 高爾也沒有看到爸爸和媽媽，他們沒有推開過高爾的房門。
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr yě méi yǒu kàn dào bà ba hé mā ma tā men méi yǒu tuī kāi guò gāo ěr de fáng mén
sentences.english: Gao Er didn’t see his father or mother either. They didn’t open the door to Gao Er’s room.

sentences.simplified: 有时候，高尔真想爬出去看看他们，但他不敢，他害怕。
sentences.traditional: 有時候，高爾真想爬出去看看他們，但他不敢，他害怕。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu shí hou gāo ěr zhēn xiǎng pá chū qù kàn kan tā men dàn tā bù gǎn tā hài pà
sentences.english: There were times when Gao Er really wanted to go out and see them, but he didn’t dare to. He was scared.

sentences.simplified: 晚上，在黑黑的房间里，他好像听到娃娃问：“你害怕什么？”
sentences.traditional: 晚上，在黑黑的房間裡，他好像聽到娃娃問：“你害怕什麼？”
sentences.pinyin: wǎn shang zài hēi hēi de fáng jiān lǐ tā hǎo xiàng tīng dào wá wá wèn nǐ hài pà shén me
sentences.english: At night, in the dark room, he seemed to hear the teddy bear ask, “What are you afraid of?”

sentences.simplified: 他不知道怎么回答。他不会回答，他不敢回答。
sentences.traditional: 他不知道怎麼回答。他不會回答，他不敢回答。
sentences.pinyin: tā bù zhī dào zěn me huí dá tā bú huì huí dá tā bù gǎn huí dá
sentences.english: He didn’t know how to answer. He didn’t know how to answer, nor did he dare answer.

sentences.simplified: 但是，这还不是最让他难过的事情。
sentences.traditional: 但是，這還不是最讓他難過的事情。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì zhè hái bú shì zuì ràng tā nán guò de shì qing
sentences.english: However, this was not the thing that upset him the most.

sentences.simplified: 每天，他想得最多的问题是，他不能工作了，
sentences.traditional: 每天，他想得最多的問題是，他不能工作了，
sentences.pinyin: měi tiān tā xiǎng de zuì duō de wèn tí shì tā bù néng gōng zuò le
sentences.english: Every day, the thing he thought about the most was that he could no longer work.

sentences.simplified: 家里马上就没钱了，怎么办？
sentences.traditional: 家裡馬上就沒錢了，怎麼辦？
sentences.pinyin: jiā lǐ mǎ shàng jiù méi qián le zěn me bàn
sentences.english: Soon, there would be no money left at home. What would they do?

sentences.simplified: 以前家里有个保姆，就住在楼下，
sentences.traditional: 以前家裡有個保姆，就住在樓下，
sentences.pinyin: yǐ qián jiā lǐ yǒu ge bǎo mǔ jiù zhù zài lóu xià
sentences.english: Before, the family had a nanny at home who lived downstairs.

sentences.simplified: 每天帮家里做些家务，照顾爸爸和妈妈。
sentences.traditional: 每天幫家裡做些家務，照顧爸爸和媽媽。
sentences.pinyin: měi tiān bāng jiā lǐ zuò xiē jiā wù zhào gù bà ba hé mā ma
sentences.english: Every day, she helped with the housework and took care of Gao Er’s father and mother.

sentences.simplified: 这几天，高尔已经没有听到这个保姆的声音了。
sentences.traditional: 這幾天，高爾已經沒有聽到這個保姆的聲音了。
sentences.pinyin: zhè jǐ tiān gāo ěr yǐ jīng méi yǒu tīng dào zhè ge bǎo mǔ de shēng yīn le
sentences.english: These past few days, Gao Er hadn’t heard the nanny’s voice.

sentences.simplified: 是因为没有钱，所以爸爸妈妈让保姆离开了吗？
sentences.traditional: 是因為沒有錢，所以爸爸媽媽讓保姆離開了嗎？
sentences.pinyin: shì yīn wèi méi yǒu qián suǒ yǐ bà ba mā ma ràng bǎo mǔ lí kāi le ma
sentences.english: Was it because there was no money that his father and mother let the nanny go?

sentences.simplified: 如果保姆离开了，那谁来照顾爸爸妈妈呢？
sentences.traditional: 如果保姆離開了，那誰來照顧爸爸媽媽呢？
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ bǎo mǔ lí kāi le nà shéi lái zhào gù bà ba mā ma ne
sentences.english: If the nanny left, who would take care of his father and mother?

sentences.simplified: 爸爸老了，妈妈身体不好，他们需要人照顾啊！
sentences.traditional: 爸爸老了，媽媽身體不好，他們需要人照顧啊！
sentences.pinyin: bà ba lǎo le mā ma shēn tǐ bù hǎo tā men xū yào rén zhào gù a
sentences.english: His father was getting old, and his mother was not in good health. They needed someone to take care of them!

sentences.simplified: 还有妹妹，那可爱的妹妹，她的学费怎么办？
sentences.traditional: 還有妹妹，那可愛的妹妹，她的學費怎麼辦？
sentences.pinyin: hái yǒu mèi mei nà kě ài de mèi mei tā de xué fèi zěn me bàn
sentences.english: And his little sister, his cute little sister, what about her tuition fees?

sentences.simplified: 她那么喜欢弹钢琴，她要去音乐学校。
sentences.traditional: 她那麼喜歡彈鋼琴，她要去音樂學校。
sentences.pinyin: tā nà me xǐ huan tán gāng qín tā yào qù yīn yuè xué xiào
sentences.english: She loved playing the piano so much, and she wanted to go to music school.

sentences.simplified: 现在没有钱交学费，她怎么去音乐学校呢？
sentences.traditional: 現在沒有錢交學費，她怎麼去音樂學校呢？
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài méi yǒu qián jiāo xué fèi tā zěn me qù yīn yuè xué xiào ne
sentences.english: If there was no money to pay for tuition now, how would she go to music school?

sentences.simplified: 还有爸爸欠银行的那些钱，是每个月都要还的，怎么办呢？
sentences.traditional: 還有爸爸欠銀行的那些錢，是每個月都要還的，怎麼辦呢？
sentences.pinyin: hái yǒu bà ba qiàn yín háng de nà xiē qián shì měi ge yuè dōu yào huán de zěn me bàn ne
sentences.english: And there was the money that his father owed the bank, which needed to be paid back every month. What would they do?

sentence_translations: Chapter 7: What Are You Afraid Of?
Gao Er’s little sister brought him some food. Although he only saw his little sister’s hand, Gao Er was still very happy.
Gao Er suddenly gained strength.
He crawled down from the bed and went to the plate. He started eating bread and drinking milk.
The bread was really delicious, and the milk was really good!
He hadn’t eaten anything for several days. He loved bread and milk so much!
But Gao Er was only happy for a moment. After he finished eating, he began to worry and feel sad again.
Just now, Gao Er only saw his little sister’s hand.
He didn’t know what his little sister’s face looked like. Was she still as scared as she was that day?
In the evening, his little sister came back from school.
She gently pushed the door open and quickly took away the plate and the cup.
Gao Er could still only see his little sister’s hand.
He wanted to talk to his little sister, but he didn’t dare to make a sound.
Just like that, one week passed.
Every morning, Gao Er’s little sister would push a plate in from outside the door.
In the evening, his little sister would take the plate away.
Gao Er did not exchange any words with his little sister, nor did he see his little sister’s face.
Gao Er didn’t see his father or mother either. They didn’t open the door to Gao Er’s room.
There were times when Gao Er really wanted to go out and see them, but he didn’t dare to. He was scared.
At night, in the dark room, he seemed to hear the teddy bear ask, “What are you afraid of?”
He didn’t know how to answer. He didn’t know how to answer, nor did he dare answer.
However, this was not the thing that upset him the most.
Every day, the thing he thought about the most was that he could no longer work.
Soon, there would be no money left at home. What would they do?
Before, the family had a nanny at home who lived downstairs.
Every day, she helped with the housework and took care of Gao Er’s father and mother.
These past few days, Gao Er hadn’t heard the nanny’s voice.
Was it because there was no money that his father and mother let the nanny go?
If the nanny left, who would take care of his father and mother?
His father was getting old, and his mother was not in good health. They needed someone to take care of them!
And his little sister, his cute little sister, what about her tuition fees?
She loved playing the piano so much, and she wanted to go to music school.
If there was no money to pay for tuition now, how would she go to music school?
And there was the money that his father owed the bank, which needed to be paid back every month. What would they do?
